description: Bounded music-phrase slice (ticket #11): the fixed fight boot path (1P Ryu vs CPU Retsu, no fight inputs). At 2280 the main CPU sends music command 0x28 (the round music); the phrase compared is frames 2280..=2359: all channels keyed off, a three-voice stab (2280-2297), a six-voice chord (2307), and the first melody notes on channels 3-5, ending one frame before the next chord (2360). Checkpoints every frame over 2279..=2360 carry the music CPU RAM. See docs/reference/music-phrase.md.
